verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents building automations and flows, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows per-profile visibility into a person's position within a flow, or the ability to remove or re-enter an individual without disrupting the flow. Generic flow-building and event/profile APIs are adjacent building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
